 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth.users WHERE id=r.account_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id=r.account_id)\n   OR NOT (r.evidence @> '{\"database\":true,\"auth\":true,\"storage\":true,\"providers\":true}'::jsonb) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'terminal_verification_failed'; END IF;\n  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM storage.objects WHERE owner_id=r.account_id::text) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'storage_remaining'; END IF;\n  PERFORM private.finalize_deletion_proof(v_id);\n ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown_command'; END IF;\n RETURN '{\"ok\":true}'::jsonb;\nEND $function$\n"},{"args":"p_table text, p_row jsonb","name":"deletion_has_incoming","schema":"private","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.deletion_has_incoming(p_table text, p_row jsonb)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\nDECLARE fk record;pair record;predicate text;missing boolean;found boolean;\nBEGIN\n FOR fk IN SELECT oid,conrelid,confrelid,conkey,confkey FROM pg_constraint\n  WHERE contype='f' AND confrelid=to_regclass('public.'||p_table) LOOP\n  predicate:='';missing:=false;\n  FOR pair IN SELECT ca.attname AS child,pa.attname AS parent FROM\n   unnest(fk.conkey,fk.confkey) AS keys(childnum,parentnum)\n   JOIN pg_attribute ca ON ca.attrelid=fk.conrelid AND ca.attnum=keys.childnum\n   JOIN pg_attribute pa ON pa.attrelid=fk.confrelid AND pa.attnum=keys.parentnum LOOP\n   IF p_row->>pair.parent IS NULL THEN missing:=true;EXIT;END IF;\n   predicate:=predicate||CASE WHEN predicate='' THEN '' ELSE ' AND ' END||format('%I::text=%L',pair.child,p_row->>pair.parent);\n  END LOOP;\n  IF missing THEN CONTINUE; END IF;\n  EXECUTE format('SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM %s WHERE %s)',fk.conrelid::regclass,predicate) INTO found;\n  IF found THEN RETURN true;END IF;\n END LOOP;\n RETURN false;\nEND $function$\n"},{"args":"p_table text, p_id text","name":"deletion_resource_visible","schema":"private","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.deletion_resource_visible(p_table text, p_id text)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.account_deletion_cases WHERE resource_table=p_table\n  AND resource_id=p_id AND restrict_access AND resolved_at IS NULL)\n$function$\n"},{"args":"p_account uuid, p_request uuid","name":"deletion_cleanup_shared","schema":"private","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.deletion_cleanup_shared(p_account uuid, p_request uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\nDECLARE resource record;rowdata jsonb;id_column text;predicate text;progress int;rounds int:=0;n int;cases int;\nBEGIN\n -- Inherited ownership is exact, and the child answer rows have no other parent.\n DELETE FROM public.discovery_answers WHERE discovery_id IN(SELECT id FROM public.discovery_records WHERE profile_id=p_account);\n DELETE FROM public.onboarding_state WHERE profile_id=p_account;\n LOOP\n  progress:=0;rounds:=rounds+1;\n  FOR resource IN SELECT * FROM private.deletion_resource_registry WHERE household_scoped\n   AND table_name NOT IN ('household_members','change_log','onboarding_state') LOOP\n   predicate:=format('%I=$1',resource.owner_column);\n   IF resource.owner_column='owner_profile_id' THEN predicate:=predicate||' AND scope NOT IN (''household'',''child'')';END IF;\n   FOR rowdata IN EXECUTE format('SELECT to_jsonb(t) FROM public.%I t WHERE %s AND NOT private.deletion_has_incoming(%L,to_jsonb(t)) LIMIT 50',resource.table_name,predicate,resource.table_name) USING p_account LOOP\n    IF NOT private.deletion_has_incoming(resource.table_name,rowdata) THEN\n     EXECUTE format('DELETE FROM public.%I WHERE id=$1 AND %I=$2',resource.table_name,resource.owner_column) USING (rowdata->>'id')::uuid,p_account;\n     GET DIAGNOSTICS n=ROW_COUNT;progress:=progress+n;\n    END IF;\n   END LOOP;\n  END LOOP;\n  EXIT WHEN progress=0 OR rounds>=20;\n END LOOP;\n DELETE FROM public.change_log WHERE owner_profile_id=p_account;\n -- Exact unresolved rows become restricted cases. No payload content enters the audit ledger.\n FOR resource IN SELECT * FROM private.deletion_resource_registry WHERE household_scoped\n  AND table_name NOT IN ('change_log','onboarding_state') LOOP\n  FOR rowdata IN EXECUTE format('SELECT to_jsonb(t) FROM public.%I t WHERE %I=$1',resource.table_name,resource.owner_column) USING p_account LOOP\n   INSERT INTO public.account_deletion_cases(request_id,resource_table,resource_id,reason)\n    VALUES(p_request,resource.table_name,rowdata->>'id','shared_or_referenced_resource_requires_resolution')\n    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n  END LOOP;\n END LOOP;\n INSERT INTO public.account_deletion_cases(request_id,resource_table,resource_id,reason)\n  SELECT p_request,'household_members',child.id::text,'child_ownership_not_inferred_from_membership'\n  FROM public.household_members child WHERE child.member_type='child' AND child.household_id IN\n   (SELECT household_id FROM public.household_members WHERE profile_id=p_account) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n INSERT INTO public.account_deletion_cases(request_id,resource_table,resource_id,reason)\n  VALUES(p_request,'profiles',p_account::text,'profile_references_require_shared_resolution') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;\n SELECT count(*) INTO cases FROM public.account_deletion_cases WHERE request_id=p_request AND resolved_at IS NULL;\n UPDATE public.account_deletion_requests SET evidence=evidence||jsonb_build_object('shared_policy','DELETE_ACCOUNT_OWNED_ESCALATE_SHARED',\n  'unresolved_resources',cases,'private_cleanup_rounds',rounds) WHERE id=p_request;\n RETURN jsonb_build_object('partial',true,'unresolved',cases,'more_work',progress>0 AND rounds>=20);\nEND $function$\n"},{"args":"","name":"deletion_bind_fingerprint","schema":"private","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.deletion_bind_fingerprint()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN\n  NEW.account_fingerprint:=encode(sha256(convert_to('herkeys-deletion:'||NEW.account_id::text,'UTF8')),'hex');\n ELSIF NEW.account_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.account_id AND NEW.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'deletion_identity_is_immutable';\n END IF;\n RETURN NEW;\nEND $function$\n"},{"args":"p_case uuid, p_resolution_reference text","name":"herkeys_resolve_deletion_case","schema":"public","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.herkeys_resolve_deletion_case(p_case uuid, p_resolution_reference text)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\nDECLARE c public.account_deletion_cases;remaining boolean;\nBEGIN\n IF length(p_resolution_reference) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 200 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'resolution_reference_required'; END IF;\n SELECT * INTO c FROM public.account_deletion_cases WHERE id=p_case FOR UPDATE;\n IF NOT FOUND OR c.resolved_at IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'case_not_open'; END IF;\n IF c.resource_table NOT IN (SELECT table_name FROM private.deletion_resource_registry UNION SELECT 'profiles') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unclassified_resource'; END IF;\n -- Closing a case cannot itself make retained personal data visible. Reviewed redaction/reconciliation must happen first.\n EXECUTE format('SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.%I WHERE id::text=$1)',c.resource_table) INTO remaining USING c.resource_id;\n IF remaining THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'resource_still_exists_requires_reviewed_reconciliation'; END IF;\n UPDATE public.account_deletion_cases SET resolved_at=clock_timestamp(),resolution_reference=p_resolution_reference WHERE id=p_case;\nEND $function$\n"},{"args":"p_account uuid, p_feature text, p_household uuid, p_idempotency_key text, p_request_id text, p_app_version text, p_units integer, p_complete_now boolean","name":"premium_authorize","schema":"public","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.premium_authorize(p_account uuid, p_feature text, p_household uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_request_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_app_version text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_units integer DEFAULT 1, p_complete_now boolean DEFAULT false)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_now      timestamptz := clock_timestamp();\n  cfg        public.premium_feature_config%ROWTYPE;\n  rt         public.premium_runtime_config%ROWTYPE;\n  ev         public.premium_usage_events%ROWTYPE;\n  v_state    text := 'unknown';\n  v_reason   text := NULL;\n  v_next     text := 'none';\n  v_checks   jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_entitled boolean := false;\n  v_via      text := NULL;\n  v_limit    integer;\n  v_period   date;\n  v_end      date;\n  v_cost     integer;\n  v_claim    uuid := NULL;\n  v_reclaimed boolean := false;\n  v_replay   boolean := false;\n  v_used     integer := 0;\n  v_reserved integer := 0;\n  v_rows     integer;\n  v_recent   integer;\n  v_quota    jsonb := NULL;\n  v_audit    uuid := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_consent  boolean;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO rt FROM public.premium_runtime_config WHERE singleton;\n  SELECT * INTO cfg FROM public.premium_feature_config WHERE feature_key = p_feature;\n\n  <<decide>>\n  BEGIN\n    -- 0. request shape\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      v_reason := 'feature_disabled'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('feature_exists', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n    IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR length(p_idempotency_key) NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 128\n       OR p_units IS NULL OR p_units < 1 OR p_units > cfg.max_units_per_request THEN\n      v_reason := 'invalid_request'; EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- 2. account lifecycle (identity was verified by the Edge Function; the account id is the JWT subject)\n    IF public.premium_account_lifecycle(p_account) <> 'active' THEN\n      v_state := CASE WHEN public.premium_account_lifecycle(p_account) = 'deletion_pending' THEN 'deletion_pending' ELSE 'unknown' END;\n      v_reason := 'account_deactivated'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('lifecycle', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n    v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('lifecycle', true);\n    v_state := public.premium_entitlement_state(p_account, v_now);\n\n    -- 3. ownership: a household id the client supplies never overrides server-verified membership\n    IF cfg.scope = 'household' AND p_household IS NULL THEN\n      v_reason := 'ownership_denied'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('ownership', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n    IF p_household IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM public.household_members m\n      WHERE m.household_id = p_household AND m.profile_id = p_account AND m.member_type = 'adult') THEN\n      v_reason := 'ownership_denied'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('ownership', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n    v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('ownership', true);\n\n    -- 4. feature enabled, released, not killed, app version\n    IF NOT cfg.enabled OR NOT cfg.released OR cfg.kill_switch THEN\n      v_reason := 'feature_disabled'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('feature_enabled', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n    IF NOT public.premium_version_gte(p_app_version, cfg.min_app_version) THEN\n      v_reason := 'feature_disabled'; v_next := 'update_app'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('app_version', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n    v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('feature_enabled', true);\n\n    -- 5. backend operational readiness\n    IF NOT rt.premium_enabled THEN\n      v_reason := 'service_unavailable'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('ready', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- Staging-only, server-enforced tester membership. Auth app metadata is writable\n    -- ONLY via the Supabase Admin API, never the account's raw_user_meta_data.\n    -- This is NOT a paid entitlement. A tester still needs a genuine provider\n    -- reconciliation for Premium to authorize a paid operation.\n    IF rt.environment = 'staging' AND cfg.tier = 'premium' AND cfg.rollout_status = 'staging_only' THEN\n      IF NOT EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id = p_account\n        AND u.raw_app_meta_data->>'herkeys_premium_tester' = 'true'\n      ) THEN\n        v_reason := 'feature_disabled';\n        v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('staging_allowlist', false);\n        EXIT decide;\n      END IF;\n      v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('staging_allowlist', true);\n    END IF;\n\n    -- 6. entitlement, or an APPROVED free allowance. Premium state is never inferred from anything but the projection.\n    v_entitled := v_state IN ('premium_active', 'premium_canceled_active', 'premium_billing_grace');\n    IF cfg.tier = 'free' THEN\n      v_via := 'free';\n    ELSIF v_entitled THEN\n      v_via := 'premium';\n    ELSIF cfg.free_allowance_status = 'approved' AND cfg.free_allowance > 0 AND v_state IN ('free', 'unknown', 'premium_expired', 'premium_revoked') THEN\n      v_via := 'free_allowance';\n    ELSE\n      v_reason := CASE v_state\n        WHEN 'unknown' THEN 'entitlement_unknown'\n        WHEN 'premium_expired' THEN 'entitlement_expired'\n        WHEN 'premium_revoked' THEN 'entitlement_expired'\n        ELSE 'requires_premium' END;\n      v_next := CASE v_state WHEN 'unknown' THEN 'retry_verification' ELSE 'open_paywall' END;\n      v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('entitlement', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n    v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('entitlement', true, 'via', v_via);\n\n    -- 7. AI consent (only where an external AI provider would see her content)\n    IF cfg.requires_ai_consent THEN\n      SELECT (c.policy_version = rt.ai_policy_version AND c.granted) INTO v_consent\n        FROM public.account_consents c WHERE c.account_id = p_account AND c.consent_type = 'ai_processing'\n        ORDER BY c.recorded_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 1;\n      IF v_consent IS NOT TRUE THEN\n        v_reason := 'requires_ai_consent'; v_next := 'grant_ai_consent'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('ai_consent', false); EXIT decide;\n      END IF;\n      v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('ai_consent', true);\n    END IF;\n\n    -- 8. quota and cost budget (atomic reservation)\n    v_period := public.premium_period_start(cfg.quota_period, v_now);\n    v_end := public.premium_period_end(cfg.quota_period, v_period);\n    v_cost := cfg.cost_weight * p_units;\n    v_limit := CASE v_via WHEN 'premium' THEN cfg.premium_limit WHEN 'free_allowance' THEN cfg.free_allowance ELSE NULL END;\n    IF cfg.quota_period = 'none' THEN v_limit := NULL; END IF;\n\n    PERFORM public.premium_expire_stale(p_account, p_feature);\n\n    -- claim the idempotency key first, so a concurrent duplicate waits on this row instead of double-charging\n    INSERT INTO public.premium_usage_events (account_id, feature_key, idempotency_key, status, units, cost_units, via, period_start)\n      VALUES (p_account, p_feature, p_idempotency_key, 'pending', p_units, v_cost, v_via, v_period)\n      ON CONFLICT (account_id, feature_key, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING\n      RETURNING id INTO v_claim;\n    IF v_claim IS NULL THEN\n      SELECT * INTO ev FROM public.premium_usage_events\n        WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key FOR UPDATE;\n      IF ev.status IN ('reserved', 'completed') THEN\n        v_replay := true; v_period := ev.period_start; v_via := ev.via;\n        v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('idempotent_replay', true);\n        EXIT decide;\n      END IF;\n      -- failed / expired / rejected: the same operation may be retried under the same key\n      UPDATE public.premium_usage_events SET status = 'pending', units = p_units, cost_units = v_cost, via = v_via,\n        period_start = v_period, created_at = v_now, completed_at = NULL WHERE id = ev.id;\n      v_claim := ev.id; v_reclaimed := true;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- per-account rate limit\n    SELECT count(*) INTO v_recent FROM public.premium_usage_events\n      WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND created_at >= v_now - INTERVAL '1 minute' AND id <> v_claim;\n    IF v_recent >= cfg.rate_limit_per_minute THEN\n      v_reason := 'rate_limited'; v_next := 'retry_later'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('rate', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- per-account counter: ONE conditional UPDATE under the row lock is the whole race defence\n    IF v_limit IS NOT NULL THEN\n      INSERT INTO public.premium_usage (account_id, feature_key, period_start) VALUES (p_account, p_feature, v_period)\n        ON CONFLICT (account_id, feature_key, period_start) DO NOTHING;\n      IF p_complete_now THEN\n        UPDATE public.premium_usage SET used = used + p_units, updated_at = now()\n          WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND period_start = v_period AND used + reserved + p_units <= v_limit;\n      ELSE\n        UPDATE public.premium_usage SET reserved = reserved + p_units, updated_at = now()\n          WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND period_start = v_period AND used + reserved + p_units <= v_limit;\n      END IF;\n      GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;\n      IF v_rows = 0 THEN\n        v_reason := 'quota_exhausted'; v_next := CASE v_via WHEN 'free_allowance' THEN 'open_paywall' ELSE 'wait_for_reset' END;\n        v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('quota', false); EXIT decide;\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- global daily cost cap (compensates the per-account reservation on refusal)\n    IF cfg.global_daily_cost_cap IS NOT NULL THEN\n      INSERT INTO public.premium_usage_global (feature_key, day) VALUES (p_feature, (v_now AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date)\n        ON CONFLICT (feature_key, day) DO NOTHING;\n      UPDATE public.premium_usage_global SET cost_units = cost_units + v_cost\n        WHERE feature_key = p_feature AND day = (v_now AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND cost_units + v_cost <= cfg.global_daily_cost_cap;\n      GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;\n      IF v_rows = 0 THEN\n        IF v_limit IS NOT NULL THEN\n          IF p_complete_now THEN\n            UPDATE public.premium_usage SET used = GREATEST(used - p_units, 0) WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND period_start = v_period;\n          ELSE\n            UPDATE public.premium_usage SET reserved = GREATEST(reserved - p_units, 0) WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND period_start = v_period;\n          END IF;\n        END IF;\n        v_reason := 'quota_exhausted'; v_next := 'wait_for_reset'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('budget', false); EXIT decide;\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n\n    UPDATE public.premium_usage_events SET status = CASE WHEN p_complete_now THEN 'completed' ELSE 'reserved' END,\n      completed_at = CASE WHEN p_complete_now THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END WHERE id = v_claim;\n    v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('quota', true);\n  END decide;\n\n  -- Refusal after claiming a key: a fresh claim is removed, a reclaimed one goes back to `rejected`.\n  IF v_reason IS NOT NULL AND v_claim IS NOT NULL THEN\n    IF v_reclaimed THEN UPDATE public.premium_usage_events SET status = 'rejected', completed_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = v_claim;\n    ELSE DELETE FROM public.premium_usage_events WHERE id = v_claim AND status = 'pending'; END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- quota snapshot for the response (never content)\n  IF cfg.feature_key IS NOT NULL AND cfg.quota_period <> 'none' THEN\n    SELECT COALESCE(u.used, 0), COALESCE(u.reserved, 0) INTO v_used, v_reserved FROM (SELECT 1) s\n      LEFT JOIN public.premium_usage u ON u.account_id = p_account AND u.feature_key = p_feature AND u.period_start = public.premium_period_start(cfg.quota_period, v_now);\n    v_limit := CASE WHEN v_via = 'free_allowance' THEN cfg.free_allowance WHEN v_via = 'premium' THEN cfg.premium_limit\n                    ELSE COALESCE(CASE WHEN v_entitled THEN cfg.premium_limit END, NULLIF(cfg.free_allowance, 0)) END;\n    v_period := public.premium_period_start(cfg.quota_period, v_now);\n    v_quota := jsonb_build_object(\n      'period', cfg.quota_period, 'periodStart', v_period, 'periodEnd', public.premium_period_end(cfg.quota_period, v_period),\n      'used', v_used, 'reserved', v_reserved, 'limit', v_limit,\n      'remaining', CASE WHEN v_limit IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(v_limit - v_used - v_reserved, 0) END);\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_account IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth.users WHERE id = p_account) THEN\n    INSERT INTO public.premium_authorization_audit (id, account_id, feature_key, outcome, reason, entitlement_state, checks, request_id)\n      VALUES (v_audit, p_account, left(COALESCE(p_feature, ''), 64), CASE WHEN v_reason IS NULL THEN 'allowed' ELSE 'denied' END,\n              COALESCE(v_reason, 'allowed'), v_state, v_checks, left(p_request_id, 80));\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'outcome', CASE WHEN v_reason IS NULL THEN 'allowed' ELSE 'denied' END,\n    'reason', COALESCE(v_reason, 'allowed'),\n    'entitlementState', v_state,\n    'via', v_via,\n    'nextAction', CASE WHEN v_reason IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE v_next END,\n    'quota', v_quota,\n    'decisionId', v_audit,\n    'replay', v_replay);\nEND\n$function$\n"},{"args":"","name":"premium_my_entitlement","schema":"public","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.premium_my_entitlement()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_account uuid := auth.uid(); e public.premium_entitlements%ROWTYPE; v_state text;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_account IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('state', 'unknown'); END IF;\n  v_state := public.premium_entitlement_state(v_account);\n  SELECT * INTO e FROM public.premium_entitlements WHERE account_id = v_account;\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'state', v_state,\n    'expiresAt', CASE WHEN v_state LIKE 'premium_%' THEN e.expires_at END,\n    'graceExpiresAt', CASE WHEN v_state = 'premium_billing_grace' THEN e.grace_expires_at END,\n    'canceled', COALESCE(e.canceled_at IS NOT NULL, false) AND v_state IN ('premium_canceled_active'),\n    'needsReconcile', COALESCE(e.needs_reconcile, true),\n    'checkedAt', clock_timestamp());\nEND\n$function$\n"},{"args":"p_function text","name":"invoke_deletion_worker","schema":"private","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.invoke_deletion_worker(p_function text DEFAULT 'process-account-deletions'::text)\n RETURNS bigint\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\nDECLARE ts text:=floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()))::bigint::text; signature text; target text;\nBEGIN\n IF p_function NOT IN ('process-account-deletions','monitor-account-deletions','expire-account-deletion-proofs') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_internal_endpoint'; END IF;\n SELECT project_url INTO target FROM private.deletion_scheduler_target WHERE singleton;\n IF target IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'scheduler_target_unconfigured'; END IF;\n SELECT encode(extensions.hmac(convert_to('herkeys-deletion:'||ts,'UTF8'),convert_to(secret,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')\n INTO signature FROM private.deletion_worker_key WHERE singleton;\n RETURN net.http_post(url:=target||'/functions/v1/'||p_function,\n  headers:=jsonb_build_object('Content-Type','application/json','x-deletion-timestamp',ts,'x-deletion-signature',signature),\n  body:='{}'::jsonb,timeout_milliseconds:=120000);\nEND $function$\n"},{"args":"","name":"herkeys_expire_deletion_proofs","schema":"public","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.herkeys_expire_deletion_proofs()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\nDECLARE n int;m int;remaining int;run_id uuid;at_time timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();\nBEGIN\n WITH due AS (SELECT receipt_hash FROM public.account_deletion_terminal_proofs WHERE expires_at<=at_time ORDER BY expires_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 10000)\n DELETE FROM public.account_deletion_terminal_proofs p USING due WHERE p.receipt_hash=due.receipt_hash;\n GET DIAGNOSTICS n=ROW_COUNT;\n DELETE FROM public.account_deletion_outbox WHERE public.premium_account_lifecycle(p_account) = 'deletion_pending' THEN\n    RETURN 'deletion_pending';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO rt FROM public.premium_runtime_config WHERE singleton;\n  SELECT * INTO e FROM public.premium_entitlements WHERE account_id = p_account;\n  v_found := FOUND;\n\n  -- Previously this flag did not participate in the Premium state. When a\n  -- transfer, webhook failure, or conflicting event requires reconciliation,\n  -- the last active state MUST NOT continue to grant expensive operations.\n  -- The existing premium-gate can attempt bounded provider reconciliation\n  -- after receiving entitlement_unknown; a failed provider lookup stays denied.\n  IF v_found AND e.needs_reconcile THEN\n    RETURN 'unknown';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- A signed webhook is lifecycle evidence, but does not replace an actual\n  -- subscriber read with the server secret key. Treat old, absent or\n  -- suspiciously future reconciliation timestamps as UNKNOWN for accounts\n  -- that might otherwise receive paid authorization. The generic gate\n  -- already performs one bounded reconcile on entitlement_unknown.\n  IF v_found AND e.has_entitlement AND e.source <> 'test_fixture' AND (\n    e.last_reconciled_at IS NULL\n    OR e.last_reconciled_at < p_now - make_interval(secs => rt.max_reconciled_age_seconds)\n    OR e.last_reconciled_at > p_now + interval '5 minutes'\n  ) THEN\n    RETURN 'unknown';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN public.premium_derive_state(\n    v_found, e.source, e.has_entitlement, e.expires_at, e.grace_expires_at,\n    e.canceled_at, e.revoked_at, e.expiration_confirmed_at,\n    rt.allow_test_fixtures, p_now\n  );\nEND\n$function$\n"},{"args":"p_event jsonb","name":"premium_record_event","schema":"public","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.premium_record_event(p_event jsonb)\n RETURNS public.premium_expire_stale(p_account uuid, p_feature text, p_minutes integer DEFAULT 15)\n RETURNS integer\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE r record; v_count integer := 0;\nBEGIN\n  FOR r IN\n    SELECT id, units, cost_units, period_start, created_at FROM public.premium_usage_events\n    WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND status = 'reserved'\n      AND created_at < clock_timestamp() - make_interval(mins => p_minutes)\n    FOR UPDATE\n  LOOP\n    UPDATE public.premium_usage_events SET status = 'expired', completed_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = r.id;\n    UPDATE public.premium_usage SET reserved = GREATEST(reserved - r.units, 0), updated_at = now()\n      WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND period_start = r.period_start;\n    UPDATE public.premium_usage_global SET cost_units = GREATEST(cost_units - r.cost_units, 0)\n      WHERE feature_key = public.premium_usage_events\n    WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN 'missing'; END IF;\n  IF feature_key = p_feature AND period_start = ev.period_start;\n  RETURN 'completed';\nEND\n$function$\n"},{"args":"p_account uuid, p_feature text, p_idempotency_key
